$comment: The options of sform whose values come from a fixed set (spec §4.1): each value is an item CommandCoverageTests wants covered as [Covers("<command>", "<option>=<value>")]. command: the canonical path without sform (no alias); option: its long form, or argument: arg0, arg1, … for a positional argument with a fixed set, whose values are covered as "arg0=<value>"; values: as the catalogue writes them (compared without case), every value the CLI accepts and acts on; source: where the CLI's code keeps the set, and who refuses the members left out; enum: the enum the code parses the value into (the test checks the values against its members, but those in except (the CLI refuses them) and refused (the CLI sends them, the platform refuses them), plus those in extra). Unknown fields fail the test. See docs/Platform/Cli.AutomationTests/automation-tests.md#coverage-valuesjson.

options.source: AccessPointGrantCommand: Enum.TryParse<PermissionRole>(ignoreCase), and an unknown or missing role grants Contributor; None is sent, and the API refuses it (AccessHttp: "The role None can't be granted or revoked.").

AccessPointRevokeCommand: Enum.TryParse<PermissionRole>(ignoreCase), and an unknown or missing role revokes Reader; None is sent, and the API refuses it (AccessHttp: "The role None can't be granted or revoked.").

AccountSettingsEditorCommand: UserSettingDefinitions.ParseEditorName (Configuration/UserSettingDefinitions.cs, EditorNames: a name per member of EditorType, in any case); another type ends with exit 2 ("'<type>' is no editor sform knows; use vscode, neovim, vim, custom."). Without a type the command asks in a terminal (EditorService.PromptEditorPreference).

AccountSettingsSetCommand.FindDefinition: UserSettingDefinitions.Find (Configuration/UserSettingDefinitions.cs, UserSettingDefinitions.All, the key in any case); another key, or none, ends with exit 2 ("'<key>' is no setting sform knows; the settings are editor.type, editor.command, access.project, access.view.").
AccountSettingsUnsetCommand: AccountSettingsSetCommand.FindDefinition, as for set (UserSettingDefinitions.All); another key, or none, ends with exit 2.

MachineScopes.TryParse (Commands/MachineAccess/MachineScopes.cs): the enum name, the scope string (Secrets.Read) or kebab case (secrets-read) in any case, repeated or comma-separated; MachineScopes.Names.

MachineCreateCommand: MachineScopes.TryParse, then only the management scopes (MachineScopes.ManagementNames); the CLI refuses a runtime scope with exit 2 ("… is not a management scope; give it with --scope.").
MachineCreateCommand: CredentialKinds.TryParse<MachineAccessCreateCredentialKind> (the name in any case or kebab case); CredentialKinds.Names.
MachineAuthSetCommand: CredentialKinds.TryParse<MachineCredentialKind>, repeated or comma-separated.
MachineAuthSetCommand: CredentialKinds.TryParse<MachineCredentialKind>, and one of the kinds of --credential-kind.

StorytellerListCommand.TryParseTreeRoot: subject or sbt (AnnotationTypeCodes.Subject, the default) renders the tree of subjects, responsibility or rst (AnnotationTypeCodes.Responsibility) the tree of responsibilities, in any case; another value ends with exit 2 ("Unknown tree root '<value>'; use subject (sbt) or responsibility (rst)."). The option implies --tree.
ViewTransferArguments.TryParseFormat: folder or git in any case.
ViewTransferArguments.TryParseInclude: the names of ViewArchiveContent in any case, repeated or comma-separated.
ViewTransferArguments.TryParseInclude: the names of ViewArchiveContent in any case, repeated or comma-separated.
ViewTransferArguments.TryParseExisting: the names of ViewImportExisting in any case.
ConfigGetCommand: json (the model, the default), else ConfigurationFormatNames.TryParse into ConfigurationFormat.

ConfigExportCommand.Validate: env (the default) when --format is missing, else ConfigurationReads.TryParseFormat: json (any case) is the content JSON alone, the other names ConfigurationFormatNames.TryParse into ConfigurationFormat.
ConfigExportCommand.Validate: Ascii.EqualsIgnoreCase(Mask, "bound" | "all") into MaskMode; bound when --mask is missing.
KeyValueListCommand: KeyValueLevels.Parse for each (KeyValueLevels.Names, the names of KeyValueProtection in any case).
KeyValueSetCommand.ResolveLevelAsync: KeyValueLevels.Parse; hyok encrypts on the client.
KeyValueProtectCommand (KeyValueBulkCommands.cs): KeyValueLevels.Parse, then the CLI refuses public and hyok with exit 2 (only the server-side levels can be reached).
KeyValueExportCommand.ResolveFormat: KeyValueFormats.TryParseFormat (document, flat-json, dotenv and .env are other names of the same three).
KeyValueExportCommand: KeyValueLevels.Parse for each.
KeyValueImportCommand.ResolveFormat: KeyValueFormats.TryParseFormat (document, flat-json, dotenv and .env are other names of the same three).
KeyValueImportCommand.ResolveSecretLevelAsync: the level of the keys --secret matches; public and hyok end with exit 2 (the keys are secrets, and hyok needs values encrypted on the client).
KeyValueImportCommand.ParseMode: merge (the default) or replace in any case.
KeyValuePolicySetCommand (KeyValuePolicyCommand.cs): KeyValueLevels.Parse for each, into AllowedProtections2.

KeyValuePolicySetCommand: KeyValueLevels.Parse into KeyValuePolicyUpdateDefaultSecretProtection; public is sent, and the API refuses it as the default secret level (CosmosKeyValuePolicyService: "The default secret level must be an allowed secret level").
KeyValuePolicySetCommand.ParseBool: bool.TryParse.
KeyValueRotateCommand (KeyValuePolicyCommand.cs): KeyValueLevels.Parse, then the CLI refuses all but Standard and Hsm with exit 2 (the customer rotates a byok key in their own vault).
KeyValueAuditCommand.ParseOperation: Enum.TryParse<KeyValueAuditEventOperation>(ignoreCase) and Enum.IsDefined.

SchemaTypeDiffCommand (SchemaOperations.DiffAsync): json (the default) prints the API's JSON diff; unified reads the same JSON diff and writes it as unified text (DiffResultConsoleExtensions.WriteUnifiedDiff).

SchemaAnnotationDiffCommand (SchemaOperations.DiffAsync): json (the default) prints the API's JSON diff; unified reads the same JSON diff and writes it as unified text (DiffResultConsoleExtensions.WriteUnifiedDiff).

SchemaDescendantDiffCommand (SchemaOperations.DiffAsync): json (the default) prints the API's JSON diff; unified reads the same JSON diff and writes it as unified text (DiffResultConsoleExtensions.WriteUnifiedDiff).
